notes.title: New Patch Released
notes.notes:
Players are now able to:
1) Find the score needed to achieve an S-rank on each level before fighting for high score. This is shown on right side under the level image.
2) See real-time in-game feedback on earned scores after completing each stage. The score is based on player's final performance score as well as bonus score awarded for time and damage.
